decisions.reason: Builds directly on the firm's existing construction machinery knowledge, allowing it to interpret early results and refine the rotating skip design.
Articulated construction dumper is closely related to established dumper and drivetrain expertise, supporting learning from market feedback.
Underground mine rescue vehicle requires specialized mining safety and regulatory knowledge distant from the firm's core machinery capabilities, limiting its ability to improve the product.
Compact telescopic loader leverages existing material handling and hydraulics knowledge, though slightly less related than dumpers, still within absorptive capacity.
